title: Expert Emphasizes Importance of Understanding Before Using Assistive Technologies for Special Needs
summary: Dr. Amal Abdel Mohsen Zaki Zaghbi, Head of the Educational Psychology Department at Beni Ha Faculty of Education in Egypt, highlights the necessity of proper understanding before utilizing assistive technologies for individuals with special needs.
body:
Dr. Amal Abdel Mohsen Zaki Zaghbi, Head of the Educational Psychology Department at Beni Ha Faculty of Education in Egypt, highlights the necessity of proper understanding before utilizing assistive technologies for individuals with special needs.
